name: montessori-cms-functions
description: Trusted server-side Cloud Functions for the 2D Montessori CMS (publishing, media, enquiries, scheduling, redirects, SEO, auth admin, maintenance). See src/*/README.md per capability.

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-montessori-2d --only auth,firestore "jest --runInBand --roots test/emulator --testPathIgnorePatterns=/node_modules/"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
